result.intro: your people in san antonio keep it cheap and pretty — gabe's pearl ritual + lena's reluctant river walk stamp + abuela-approved mission. all free to wander.

items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: ground fountains glowing pink/blue, trees wrapped in string lights, old brewery chimney behind. just walk, people-watch, take photos. gabe calls it saturday ritual.
items.whyYou: you're a night owl and this is dusk-done-right, free to hang which keeps your $150 intact.

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: super chill dusk vibe at the pearl — ground fountains glowing pink/blue, trees wrapped in warm string lights, and the lit-up pearl chimney behind a kid and dog playing in the spray. no food actually visible in the photo, but your caption says it's free to walk ($12 tacos if you cave), so yeah pretty budget-friendly for hanging out, just not really late-night from what we can see.

items.title: the $12 tacos at pearl
items.what: gabe says free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave. cave. food hall / taco stand right off the fountains plaza.
items.whyYou: foodie move that still fits — one cheap eat, rest free.

items.title: river walk 20-minute loop
items.what: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, boat with red lights down the water. lena says dusk only, 20 mins max, don't eat down here — go eat at pearl after.
items.whyYou: quick night-owl photo loop, artsy lights + reflections, then bounce like a local.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

items.title: mission san josé arches
items.what: long wall of weathered stone arches, two rows, 300 years old. national park, free. quiet cloudy-sunday vibe, perfect for sketching / staring.
items.whyYou: for your art-people side — repeating arches + texture, and it's free so budget stays safe.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
evidence.sawLive: it's a super weathered stone wall with two rows of arches and green bushes in front, cloudy sky overhead. totally good for art/architecture lovers, the rough texture and repeating arches are the main detail up close.
